_protocol_correction: 2026-08-11: the battery described below (with_sample/with_shuffle heavy battery, uniform-392 eval) was RETRACTED after code audit; see SPATIAL_REASONING_DECISION_LOG 'battery drift' entry. The corrected campaign battery is the frozen Paper-2 legacy Tier-A/B/C protocol (normal, shuffle, relcomp, facingcomp, hflip_flip, hflip_invariant) via scripts/grounding/run_seed_battery.py. This document is retained as audit history; training inputs/recipe/splits/seed semantics are unaffected.
approval: User approved all three campaign decisions on 2026-08-11: (1) implement + pre-register battery, (2) split frozen at 42 with train-time RNG varying per seed, (3) full 3x2 campaign in background runs.
purpose: Re-train the two general-VSR LoRA backbones (Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct, SmolVLM2-2.2B-Instruct) under three fresh random seeds each, using training-run inputs identical to the seed-0 runs EXCEPT the seed, to study seed variance of the results and to produce seed-quality verdicts. Seed-0 artifacts live in checkpoints/qwen2vl_7b_general_lora/final and checkpoints/general_lora/final (master).

rng_semantics.note: The 95/5 train/val split mapping is FROZEN at seed=42 for every campaign run (manifest-identical assignment; only train-time RNG varies). Per-run: torch.manual_seed(SEED), torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(SEED), numpy.random.seed(SEED) are set at driver start, before model/LoRA init and DataLoader creation. The seed therefore controls: LoRA adapter init draws, DataLoader shuffle order, dropout masks. It does NOT change the manifest or the split assignment.

backbones.seed_source: scripts/run_7b_pipeline.py PHASE 2 (train_lora for 'general', verbatim copy in scripts/run_seed_campaign.py)
backbones.prompt:
Look at the image carefully.

Statement: "{statement}"

Is this statement true or false?

Answer with exactly one word: True or False.
backbones.labels: prompt tokens masked -100, only answer tokens supervised
backbones.preprocessing: raw PIL image (from data/image_cache md5 URL cache) passed to Qwen2-VL processor defaults; no manual size cap at training time (matches seed-0 training; the 392px cap is an EVALUATION contract only)
backbones.image_missing_policy: example skipped if cache image absent (seed-0 policy)
backbones.data: VSR test split rows sampled into general_train.jsonl by src/training/build_train_sets.py (legacy; not rebuilt)

backbones.seed_source: src/training/lora.py train() invoked with explicit manifest-identical args (see rng_semantics)
backbones.note: micro=1/accum=16 frozen to match the CLI defaults with which the seed-0 run was invoked (README: python -m src.training.lora --manifest data/manifests/general_train.jsonl --output checkpoints/general_lora). Seed-0 training_log.json records effective_batch_size=16 and total_steps=238; 1900/1 micro-batches x 2 epochs / 16 accum = 237.5 -> 238 matches this configuration.
backbones.collator: src/training/collator.py VSRDataCollator: apply_chat_template prompt (add_generation_prompt), answer tokens appended, labels masked to answer only
backbones.preprocessing: raw PIL image via src/training/collator.py._load_image (md5 URL cache) passed to SmolVLM2 processor defaults; no manual size cap at training time
backbones.checkpointing: checkpoint-{step} saves every eval_every=100 optimizer steps + final/ (legacy lora.py behavior)
backbones.data: VSR test split rows sampled into general_train.jsonl by src/training/build_train_sets.py (legacy; not rebuilt)

battery.image_contract: 392px long-side cap (uniform; docs/TECHNIQUES.md 4; src/grounding/config.py MAX_LONG_SIDE=392) applied to ALL conditions incl. normal
battery.sampling_policy: constant, without replacement (fixed row order produced by each condition builder; no randomized sampling in the battery)
battery.inference: greedy (do_sample=False), answer-token probe / one-word True|False classification

conditions.description: VSR test rows, image 392px cap, statements/labels as-is. Reference condition.
Rows duplicated with a numerically-distinct 2px-resized copy of the same image (numerical identity jitter within 2px tolerance); statement/label unchanged.
Same rows+images as normal, row order shuffled (constant, without replacement, fixed permutation recorded per run); tests order-invariance.

Relation-comparison condition: relation pairs whose normalized semantic distance < 0.3 (per VSR relation hierarchy/embeddings used by the legacy hardneg manifest builder); statement uses the comparison relation.
Orientation-facing subset (statements with facing/facing-away semantics; rows shared with the grounding facing analysis).
Horizontal-flip image variant built by the legacy hardneg manifest builder (flip + label inversion contract of that builder).
hflip variant where the statement is additionally inverted/negated (per legacy hardneg builder's inverse variant).

builders.with_sample: PIL resize by 2px on the 392px image
builders.with_shuffle: fixed permutation derived from the row index (deterministic)
builders.facing: row filter on relation semantics + 392px contract (reuses grounding facing rows)

per_seed: report metrics per condition incl. accuracy, agreement with seed-0, per-family breakdown
across_seeds: mean +/- std per condition per backbone; compare to seed-0 values; seed-quality verdict (distance from seed-0 / spread)
family_drift: per-family (orientation/depth/horizontal/...) accuracy across seeds; adaptation curves from training logs
systematic_conditions: extreme-accuracy conditions (>=0.99 or <=0.01) inspected per seed; hflip/hflip_inv behavior
verdicts: per-seed PASS/REVIEW/FAIL vs seed-0 reference values recorded in this campaign
deliverables: frozen configs (this file), 6 adapters + training logs, battery metrics, analysis report, decision-log stamps

drift_notes: The HEAVY eval battery (conditions above) had NO implementation anywhere in the repo (verified: master + all remote branches); it existed only as a spec (aftertrain.md). The full battery was therefore implemented + PRE-REGISTERED in this campaign (configs/seed_campaign/BATTERY_JUSTIFICATION.md).
Seed-0 training runs were unseeded (no manual_seed); the campaign adds explicit per-run seeds - this is the ONLY intentional difference from the legacy training runs.

2B split-seed ambiguity (train() defaults micro=4/accum=4 vs CLI defaults micro=1/accum=16) resolved in favor of the CLI defaults that the seed-0 run used (see smolvlm2_2b note); effective_batch_size=16 identical either way.
